name: Weston Lane
tagline: I build games, real-time tools, and the systems that hold them together.
marquee: ✦ COMPUTER SCIENTIST ✦ RUTGERS GRAD ✦ COAST GUARD VETERAN ✦ THANKS FOR VISITING ✦
intro: I'm a multidisciplinary software engineer specializing in simulation experiences. I pursue a better understanding of the intersection of art and software. Mostly familiar with Unity but have delved into personal render engine development and other tools.
Previous Avionics Electrical Technician in the United States Coast Guard. I am reliable, ready, and a strong problem solver. Thanks for stopping by!
about: Hi, if you're this deep in the link tree then you must be actually trying to learn more about me.
Before pursuing my studies I was in the United States Coast Guard. This was a formative experience for me and taught me how to manage my adult life.

After the Coast Guard I decided to pursue my studies at Rutgers University New Brunswick. I have developed a passion for some niches in software development specifically rendering, simulation, and game development.
I am a Mentor in the Rutgers Game Development Club, where I teach others how to write clean code, make games, and use Unity.
Outside of that I love to play guitar (you can see in my photo, yes that is a real deer), play video games, and dabble in cocktail mixology.
